# youtubemp3.sbs

## Free YouTube to MP3 and MP4 Converter

Convert YouTube videos to high-quality MP3 audio or MP4 video files. No ads, no signup, completely free.

### Features

- Convert YouTube videos to MP3 (audio) or MP4 (video)
- High-quality output (up to 320kbps audio)
- Automatic album art embedding for MP3 files
- No registration required
- No ads or popups
- Fast conversion using yt-dlp

### How to Use

1. Paste a YouTube video URL into the input field
2. Select MP3 or MP4 format
3. Click Convert
4. Download your file
